sample_unit: ratings of LLM responses (7 surgeons x 10 questions x 3 LLMs)

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and quality of LLM responses to spondylodiscitis FAQs
links.effect: 38.6% (81/210) excellent, 39% satisfactory with minimal clarification, 16.7% moderate clarification, 5.7% (12/210) unsatisfactory; no significant median difference among 3 LLMs.
links.quote: Across all responses, 38.6% (81/210) were rated as excellent, 39% (82/210) as satisfactory with minimal clarification needed, 16.7% (35/210) as satisfactory with moderate clarification needed, and 5.7% (12/210) as unsatisfactory.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLM responses to patient FAQs regarding spondylodiscitis using expert spine surgeon raters, without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
